intro.zh:
我是墨岩，北京电影学院摄影专业2026级本科应届生，专注于静态影像与短片创作。

在静止的画面与流动的影像之间，我以摄影展开观察与表达。以下是我的部分摄影创作与短片项目。
intro.en:
I am Moyan, working across photography and cinematography.

Through still photographs and moving images, I observe and express. This is a collection of my art photography and short-film projects.

about.zh:
以摄影展开观察与表达。
在静止的画面与流动的影像之间，探索日常、空间与情绪。
about.en:
Through photography, I observe and express.
Working across still images and short films, I explore everyday life, space and emotion.

heading.zh:
静态影像。
电影摄影。

body.zh: 围绕纪实、当代与情绪、人像等方向持续拍摄，以系列组织观察与表达。
body.en: Ongoing work in documentary, contemporary photography and portraiture, developing observations into photographic series.

body.zh: 在《我才不是流浪狗》中承担摄影、剪辑与配乐选取等工作，参与从现场画面到成片节奏的组织。
body.en: On I’m Not a Stray, I contributed cinematography, editing and music selection, working from on-set images to the rhythm of the finished film.

title.zh: 剧组现场 · 持续学习

body.zh: 参与《燕云十六声》联名TVC跟组学习，协助器材与现场信息传递，积累专业剧组的协作经验。
body.en: On-set training on a Where Winds Meet collaboration TVC, assisting with equipment and production communication while learning professional workflows.

title.zh: 摄影创作 / 短片摄影

body.zh: 静态摄影项目、短片影像创作与摄影合作。
body.en: Photographic projects, short-film image-making and cinematography.

body.zh: 短片剪辑、叙事节奏与配乐选取。
body.en: Short-film editing, narrative rhythm and music selection.

title.zh: 摄影助理 / 现场协作

body.zh: 参与剧组现场工作，在明确职责的基础上协作与实践。
body.en: Contributing to productions through clearly defined support roles and practical collaboration.

body.zh: 在专业学习、个人创作与剧组实践之间持续积累，逐步建立自己的电影摄影语言。
body.en: Continuing to learn through study, personal projects and on-set practice, towards a cinematographic language of my own.

profileLine.zh: 摄影创作者 / 北京电影学院 · 2026级本科在读
profileLine.en: Image maker / Photography undergraduate · Beijing Film Academy, 2026 intake

body.zh: 从纪实到当代摄影，在真实生活与空间中寻找情绪与叙事的线索。
body.en: From documentary to contemporary photography, finding traces of emotion and narrative in everyday life and space.

body.zh: 在短片创作中探索摄影、剪辑与配乐之间的关系，让影像组织故事与感受。
body.en: Exploring the relationship between cinematography, editing and music in short films, shaping stories and feelings through images.
